prompt: Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facing directly down to player, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow beyond footprint, no text or logos. Readable when scaled down into a 16px-grid game. Match the attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline and pixel density. Match the palette, outline weight, pixel density and three-quarter top-down angle of the attached reference sprites exactly. Original character design, not resembling any Nintendo/Game Freak/Pokémon character. Generate ONE character walk sheet: Friendly wagashi shop owner with a red tenugui headscarf tied at back, white kappogi apron over muted warm clothes, dark shoes and warm smile. No backpack. Use attached NEW bucket-hat player as proportions, layout, palette and pixel density reference, not clothing. Chibi figure 13 wide and 19 logical pixels tall, head about 9 tall. EXACTLY THREE columns by FOUR rows; rows DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, UP. All row TWO face LEFT; all row THREE face RIGHT. Columns idle, step A, step B with opposite foot and arm advancing. Each cell 16x20 logical pixels; total 48x80 enlarged cleanly. Feet bottom centre. Genuine transparent background. No floor, shadow, glow, grid, labels or buildings. Simple flat clusters legible at 1x.
notes: Original chibi redesign for #42. Rows down,left,right,up; columns idle,stepA,stepB. Requires #41 renderer and exporter support for 16x20 cells.

export.method: Threshold alpha at 128; identify occupied row and column bands; crop each frame to content; nearest-neighbour fit preserving aspect within 14x19; bottom-centre in 16x20 cells; assemble 48x80; quantize to 23 RGB colors without dithering; restore alpha and zero transparent RGB.
